body: OK it appears that the `=` is being added by the bluemonday Sanitizer.

Likely at: 

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/477c4530e48c072aa3d02c9e62c8428768c443e6/vendor/github.com/microcosm-cc/bluemonday/sanitize.go#L168-L179

Bluemonday has made the common but actually non-compliant assumption that the query component must contain key=value pairs.

> Bluemonday has made the common but actually non-compliant assumption that the query component must contain key=value pairs.

Ugh, yeah that is a very bad assumption.

issue.title: Sanitize should not add forcibly add values to query components

repository.name: bluemonday
repository.description: bluemonday: a fast golang HTML sanitizer (inspired by the OWASP Java HTML Sanitizer) to scrub user generated content of XSS

issue.body:
Although query components are often key=value pairs - there is no absolute requirement
for the keys to have values and if there is not a value then the equal sign should not
be added.

Fixes go-gitea/gitea#15349

Signed-off-by: Andrew Thornton <art27@cantab.net>

body:
> Presumably this is correct enough?

Yes, decodes fine

> Technically AFAIU the / in the query component do not need to be escaped

Yes, I think `url.QueryEscape` is overzealous with the escaping. In that sample, I see no characters that require escaping. I'm not sure if query string actually requires special escaping at all, but I guess they won't hurt either.
